title: Ethan Larimore
text:
Welcome to my website!
Hi there! My name is Ethan Larimore and I’m a Junior at Rice University majoring in Statistics and Sport Analytics. At Rice, I’m fortunate to work directly with our D1 Baseball team as an Analytics Intern and regularly compete in analytics competitions. This fall, I’ll be a research assistant at Professor Scott Powers’ Lab, which focuses on projects in sport analytics.
In my free time, I enjoy playing pickup basketball, exploring Houston’s restaurant scene, and lion dancing.

title: Projects
text:
With Krish Bothra and Jenna Lau

GitHub · Paper · Poster

We developed a multi-stage modeling framework to predict key elements of the screen play before the snap using the NFL’s Big Data Bowl tracking data. By combining players’ spatial information with game contexts, our models predict screen play occurence, direction, and target receiver group while outperforming baseline approaches.
